term: founded by God: through an envoy or immediately
resolution: Modelling choice, not a sourced reading: Dei Filius ch. 3 para. 5 (per Filium) is compatible with both senses, since the Son is God on the council's theology; the envoy sense is chosen because the skeleton's Signature does not identify jesus with any IsGod being. STMT-ENVOY-FOUNDING-IS-GODS-FOUNDING reads FoundedAsTeachingAuthority in the envoy sense, restricted to Jesus as envoy; that sense includes immediate founding as a special case. With that premise, the predicate as used by STMT-BRIDGE-CHRISTS-CHURCH-FOUNDED-BY-GOD, STMT-CHRISTS-CHURCH-IS-GOD-FOUNDED-TEACHING-AUTHORITY and STMT-CATHOLIC-CHURCH-IS-GOD-FOUNDED-TEACHING-AUTHORITY covers societies Jesus founded in a God's mandate with a teaching commission. STMT-BRIDGE-GOD-FOUNDED-AUTHORITY-PROPOSES-ONLY-TRUTH quantifies over every society God founded as a teaching authority, so on this reading it also covers those societies; because the envoy premise is restricted to Jesus, it is not extended to societies founded by other envoys (e.g. Moses or the prophets of Dei Filius para. 2). The derivation never passes to the immediate-only sense: on that sense the envoy premise is false and the bridge would need a different argument. Stage 5's Founded jesus c is a separate primitive and is not God's founding by definition; the envoy premise is what connects them.
